title: Embodied AI in Social Spaces: Responsible and Adaptive Robots in Complex Settings
reasoning: The paper provides an overview of the vision and methodology for a multidisciplinary project focused on 'Responsible AI' and 'ethically grounded' robots in care settings. While ethical frameworks and Responsible Research and Innovation (RRI) are core components of the project's design philosophy, the paper does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of ethical, moral, or religious systems.
